title.suggested: Tom Allen a Regular at the Fair Grounds Races

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch noted that Tom Allen, the retired champion, and his old backer Fred Watkins were regular patrons of the races at the Fair Grounds, Allen always carrying his field glasses.
